name: ledger
description: Active hours per repo with a /hours pane, CSV export and a monthly goal line; drafts a build-in-public post when you merge a PR

idleMinutes.title: Idle minutes
idleMinutes.description: A gap between two of your prompts shorter than this counts as active time.

csvPath.title: CSV export path
csvPath.description: File the Export button writes. Empty copies the CSV to the clipboard.

hourlyRate.title: Hourly rate
hourlyRate.description: Turns hours into money on the goal line. 0 turns the goal line off.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Label shown after the amount on the goal line.

monthlyGoal.title: Monthly goal
monthlyGoal.description: Income goal per month, in the currency above. 0 turns the goal line off.

publicRepos.title: Public repos
publicRepos.description: Regex tested against a repo's owner/name and its folder. A merged PR there gets a drafted post. Empty turns drafting off.

draftsDir.title: Drafts folder
draftsDir.description: Folder the drafted posts are written to as markdown. Empty turns drafting off.

draftModel.title: Draft model
draftModel.description: Model alias or id that writes the draft.
